lines.text: Noah's three sons who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Ham fathered Canaan.
Noah planted an olive grove, drank some of its wine, became drunk, and uncovered himself inside his tent.
Ham told his two brothers outside, and Shem and Japheth covered their father while walking backward.
Noah cursed Canaan, blessed the LORD, the God of Shem, and said God may expand the territory of Japheth.
After the flood Noah lived 120 years, so he lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
